shots.prompt: Overhead view of a candlelit wooden table, a hand-drawn hex map of a river valley weighted down with a tankard, four pewter miniatures standing at the map's edge, a scatter of dice, one twenty-sided die resting on a twenty
shots.motion: The candle flame wavers. A hand enters frame and sets a fifth miniature down at the far end of the map. Slow push in on the dice.
shots.say: Every campaign begins the same way. Four people who should not trust each other, one road, and a rumour worth more than it ought to be.
shots.sfx: A quiet room, a candle guttering, dice settling on wood, no music

shots.prompt: Extreme wide shot of a river valley under low grey cloud, a rutted trade road winding between wet green hills, a walled village small in the distance, smoke from three chimneys, no travellers on the road at all
shots.motion: Rain drifts across the valley in a slow sheet. The smoke bends. Nothing moves on the road. Very slow push in toward the village.
shots.say: The valley is called Marrow Ford. For ninety years the salt carts came down that road from the pans in the east, and for ninety years nothing much happened here. That is the kind of place a story starts.
shots.sfx: Cold rain on open hillside, wind, distant rooks, no voices

titles.text:
EPISODE ONE
THE DOOR IN THE HILL

shots.prompt: Overhead view of the candlelit table, four miniatures now standing together at the mouth of a drawn tunnel on the map, a twenty-sided die rolling to a stop showing a one, a hand withdrawing
shots.motion: The die rolls, slows, and stops on a one. The hand withdraws from frame. The candle flame leans. Slow push in on the die.
shots.say: We stopped there for the night. Somebody had to drive home, and Skivv's player wanted to look up what a halfling can carry.
shots.sfx: A die rolling and stopping on wood, a chair pushed back, quiet room tone
